definitions.explanation: Having as much as is needed to meet a requirement or standard.
Having more than enough, or being satisfactorily complete and thorough.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}な{睡眠|すいみん}を{取|と}ってください。
{準備|じゅんび}は{十分|じゅうぶん}ですか。
{経験|けいけん}が{十分|じゅうぶん}でないため、もう{少|すこ}し{練習|れんしゅう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Because my experience is not sufficient, I need a bit more practice.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}な{成果|せいか}が{出|で}た。
この{説明|せつめい}で{十分|じゅうぶん}だと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I think this explanation is thorough enough.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}な{時間|じかん}をかけて{検討|けんとう}した{結果|けっか}、この{方針|ほうしん}に{決|き}めた。
examples.english: After considering it with ample time, we decided on this policy.

notes:
Also used as an adverb {十分|じゅうぶん}に (sufficiently; thoroughly). Can also be read じっぷん when meaning "ten minutes," but the na-adjective meaning is always じゅうぶん. The negative form {十分|じゅうぶん}でない or {不十分|ふじゅうぶん}な (insufficient) is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な{時間|じかん}: enough time
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な{睡眠|すいみん}: enough sleep
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な{準備|じゅんび}: adequate preparation
- {十分|じゅうぶん}な{証拠|しょうこ}: sufficient evidence
- {不十分|ふじゅうぶん}な: insufficient; inadequate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {充分|じゅうぶん}な: sufficient — variant kanji form with the same meaning and pronunciation; both are standard
- {足|た}りる: to be enough — a verb rather than an adjective; more conversational
- {豊富|ほうふ}な: abundant; rich — implies having much more than needed, especially variety
